_readme: Rotating facts for Surprise Me path. Each fact: BEN OS starts, gets cut off, MemeBot interrupts (image or greentext), BEN OS reacts, then optional second MemeBot greentext beat. localStorage prevents repeats per session.

facts.text: Did you know that Ben once built a directional sound weapon—
facts.notes: Roasts the absurdity of the fact itself. Second beat: meta, roasting the portfolio-site-that-opens-with-weapons-talk concept.

facts.text: Did you know that Ben's chess set is based on Man Ray's 1920 designs—
facts.benos_reaction: …Man Ray would have found this acceptable.
chips: Tell me about the chess set.
facts.notes: First greentext: dead artist, surprise 3D printing. Second: goes after BEN OS personality — dry, over-explains, unprompted.

facts.text: Did you know that Ben went from defense contractor to jazz club graphic designer—
facts.notes: Stanley eye roll on the career pivot. Second beat goes after BEN OS's deadpan non-explanation.

facts.text: Did you know that Ben's portfolio PDF is formatted as a classified government document—
facts.benos_reaction: …the cover says UNCLASSIFIED. That part is accurate.
facts.notes: First greentext: short punchy paranoia. Second: meta appreciation — MemeBot can't even roast it.

facts.text: Did you know that Misfortune Cookies tells you exactly what you don't want to hear—
facts.notes: Full of soup on overwhelm. Second beat: MemeBot roasts the concept but can't help respecting it.

facts.text: Did you know that Man Ray was a Dadaist who designed chess pieces nobody played with—
memebot_greentext: >literally no one plays chess with them
facts.notes: First greentext: roasts Dada. Second: goes after BEN OS's personality — dry, finds this all logical and relatable.
